name: Legacy Weapon
description: The weapon assembled from artifacts, Urza's stones, Karn's body and Gerrard's life that destroyed Yawgmoth.

description_citations.text: "Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aided by the Weatherlight crew, Gerrard sacrifices his life to activate the Legacy Weapon, defeating Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Gerrard Capashen sacrificed his life to activate the Legacy Weapon

citation.text: "Bloodline Project", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legacy Weapon saves Dominaria and seemingly destroys Yawgmoth; only Freyalise and Windgrace of the Nine survive.
timeline.quote: Freyalise, along with all of Dominaria, was saved by the activation of the Legacy Weapon, which seemingly destroyed Yawgmoth.

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth returns to Dominaria; after the Weatherlight shoots down the Null Moon, the Legacy Weapon destroys him and the Phyrexian forces lose their will to live.
timeline.quote: Phyrexian forces lost all will to live with the death of their god.

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Yawgmoth vs. The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth enters Dominaria as a Black Cloud of Death; Urza reveals the final secret of the Legacy Weapon.
timeline.quote: Urza told the crew the final secret of the Legacy Weapon .

citation.text: "Urza", section "Final Atonement". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Gerrard die activating the Legacy Weapon, which destroys Yawgmoth; Karn takes up Urza's staff and leaves Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Urza and Gerrard died in the activation, but the weapon successfully destroyed Yawgmoth.

citation.text: "Urza", section "Final Atonement". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: An ancient weapon of which the Salvation Sphere was a part.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.
